pre_condition: self has been entered via __enter__ and has an active ELP subprocess. exc_type, exc, and tb follow Python's context-manager protocol: all three are None if the managed block exited without an exception; otherwise they hold the exception type, value, and traceback of the exception that caused exit.
post_condition: The ELP subprocess started by __enter__ has been terminated and all its pipe resources have been released. The background reader thread has been stopped and is no longer consuming from the subprocess stdout. Always returns False — exceptions are never suppressed and will be re-raised automatically by the Python runtime after this method returns.
